name: @cie/tauri-agent
description: Semantic MCP control for an instrumented Tauri 2 WebView

scripts.build: pnpm clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/build-browser-bundle.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json eslint.config.js vitest.config.ts src tests/platform tests/unit tests/integration tests/contract tests/agent tests/release tests/fixtures/tauri-app/.tauri-agent.json tests/fixtures/tauri-app/package.json tests/fixtures/tauri-app/src tests/fixtures/tauri-app/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json tests/fixtures/tauri-app/src-tauri/capabilities/default.json "tests/fixtures/projects/**/*.{json,json5}"
scripts.test:platform:structural: vitest run tests/platform/ownership-proof.test.ts tests/platform/owned-launch.test.ts tests/platform/host-exception.test.ts tests/platform/provider-proof.test.ts tests/platform/background-proof.test.ts tests/platform/cargo-proof.test.ts
scripts.test:platform:windows: node tests/platform/gate.mjs windows && vitest run --no-file-parallelism tests/platform/provider-proof.test.ts tests/platform/background-proof.test.ts tests/platform/cargo-proof.test.ts
scripts.test:platform:linux: node tests/platform/gate.mjs ubuntu && vitest run --no-file-parallelism tests/platform/provider-proof.test.ts tests/platform/background-proof.test.ts tests/platform/cargo-proof.test.ts
scripts.validate: pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test && pnpm pack:check
